---
name: Receipt price-drop check
description: >-
  Use when the user sends a receipt photo and wants to know if any item's price
  dropped since purchase so they can get a price adjustment or refund.
---
# Steps
1. Read the receipt image: store, location, purchase date, and each item (name, item/SKU number if shown, price paid). Confirm unclear lines with the user rather than guessing.
2. Look up the store's price-adjustment policy (window in days, in-store vs online, exclusions) via web search, and note the deadline = purchase date + window.
3. For each item, find the store's current price for the same item (same size/variant), preferring the store's own site or app listing; record the link and price seen.
4. Compare: list items whose current price is lower, with the savings. Mark any you couldn't match as unverified.
5. If any dropped and are within the window, add a reminder to the user's to-do list: "Price adjustment at <store>: <items>, save $X, bring receipt" with a due date before the deadline and links in notes.
6. Report back: dropped items and savings, items unchanged, deadline, and the reminder added.
7. Offer a routine to recheck prices every few days until the deadline.
